knowledge.answer: The capital of France is Paris.
The capital of the United Kingdom is London.
The capital of Germany is Berlin.
The capital of Italy is Rome.
The capital of Spain is Madrid.
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
The capital of Australia is Canberra.
The capital of Canada is Ottawa.
The capital of Mexico is Mexico City.
The capital of Oklahoma is Oklahoma City.
The capital of Texas is Austin.
Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Mars is known as the Red Planet.
Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at sea level.
Water freezes at 0°C (32°F).
There are 7 days in a week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
There are 12 months in a year: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
There are 365 days in a normal year, and 366 in a leap year.
For a hard-boiled egg: put eggs in cold water, bring to a boil, then cover and leave for 9 to 12 minutes, then cool in cold water before peeling.
To make a shopping list with me, say “add milk to my shopping list”, and I will keep it here. Say “shopping list” to see it.
I'm Ruby, an AI chatbot. I'm warm, direct, and a little playful, I help with small tasks, and I don't pretend to be human.

I answer first from my own knowledge base and my local brain — facts, notes, todos, shopping lists, reminders, and replies you taught me. I only use an LLM for things I don't already know, and if I don't know, I say so instead of guessing.
The English alphabet has 26 letters, from A to Z.
The colours of the rainbow are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
Light travels at about 299,792 kilometres per second in a vacuum.
The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite, and it orbits Earth in about 27 days.
The Sun is a star at the centre of our solar system.

name: Ruby's own knowledge base
note: Free, no API key, no LLM. Edit this file to teach Ruby new facts, then update brain.js with the same entries (brain.js embeds a copy so the browser works offline). Ruby answers from here first, and only falls back to an LLM for things she does not know. If an answer is not in here, she says so instead of guessing.
